readme:
# dsh-desktop

> ⚠️ **DO NOT `npm install` this package.** This npm name is a reserved placeholder.

**dsh-desktop** 是一个 DeepSeek Harness 的原生 Windows 桌面应用（Electron）：免安装 Node.js / 命令行，下载即用 —— 安装、双击、一个窗口就打开。

**dsh-desktop** is a native Windows desktop app for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). No Node.js, no command line: download the installer, double-click, and a window opens.

## The real thing

The actual application is a native Windows desktop app (Electron shell around the DeepSeek Harness Web UI), **not an npm package**. This npm name exists only to reserve the `dsh-desktop` name and point to the official source.

- **Releases (installers / zip):** https://github.com/SnowCrescenter-tech/dsh-desktop/releases
- **Source code:** https://github.com/SnowC
